Villain is probably c-betting with numerous Broadway hands that have no incentive to keep betting on any 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, or 2. Hero also has two overcards and a backdoor flush draw. He should call and look to stab or bluff-raise on credible turn cards.
Villain bets $70. Hero raises to $225. Villain folds.

see this all the time. Villain will bet the Ri thn value, with no plan if he gets raised. The only straight combos in his range are 7-65, 6-55: 6-6, and A-6s. Meanwhile, there are dozens of weaker hands in his range: Hero has plenty of 6-x combos, pot equity and fold equity on this turn. He will also win Villain’s stack if he rivers a better straight. Bluff-raising this turn is an awesome, underutilized play.
